incident.name: Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon
incident.description: Four zero-days in Microsoft Exchange Server exploited by HAFNIUM and 10+ other APT groups. 250,000+ servers compromised.
incident.root_cause: Unpatched on-premise Exchange servers, delayed patching
incident.lessons: On-premise email servers are high-value targets. Cloud migration reduces attack surface.

relatedIncidents.name: SolarWinds SUNBURST
relatedIncidents.description: Trojanized SolarWinds Orion update compromised 18,000 organizations including US Treasury, DHS, and Fortune 500 companies.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Supply chain compromise, insufficient code signing verification
relatedIncidents.lessons: Software supply chain integrity verification is critical. Zero-trust architecture needed.
